Audit a CV partition against a prediction target

Source: R/audit.R
audit_cv.Rd

Each validation observation is compared with its fold's available training observations. Each target location is compared with the full training set. Validation observations receive weight 1/n; target weights come from prediction_target(). This function needs no response values.

Usage

audit_cv(locations, folds, target, covariance = NULL)

Arguments

locations

Numeric two-column coordinates or projected spatial points.

folds

Fold labels or an explicit list accepted by cv_folds().

target

A prediction_target() object, or target coordinates.

covariance

A spatial_covariance() or estimate_covariance() object, a correlation function, or NULL for distance diagnostics only.

Value

An object of class spcv_audit containing diagnostics, validation and target nearest distances, normalised target weights, validated folds, and the covariance specification. diagnostics is described in distance_contrasts().

Examples

xy <- cbind(seq_len(12) / 12, rep(c(0, 1), 6))
q <- prediction_target(rbind(c(0.2, 0.5), c(0.8, 0.5)))
folds <- spatial_folds(xy, k = 3)
audit_cv(xy, folds, q, spatial_covariance(0.3, 0.8))
#> Spatial CV audit
#>         A         W        J1        J2        U1        U2 
#> 0.2649988 0.2649988 0.2338896 0.1370341 0.2338896 0.1370341 
#> Diagnostics compare prediction conditions; they do not certify CV accuracy.
